profile.headline: Aspiring Data Analyst | Data Science Learner | Diploma CSE Student
profile.intro: I’m Chandan, a computer science student building my foundations in Python and data science. I enjoy turning questions into things I can explore, understand, and build.
profile.about: I’m pursuing a Diploma in Computer Science and Engineering at Subharti Polytechnic College, Meerut. I’m at the beginning of my journey in data, and I’m comfortable saying so. I know basic Python concepts such as variables and loops, and I’m learning data analysis and data science. My goal is to become a Data Analyst and gradually grow toward Data Science and Machine Learning.
